name: Four-Section Nonrealizable Class
definition: On coordinates $(a_1,a_2,b_1,b_2,i,j)$ in low-bit order, take the 26 words encoded by $\{0,1,2,3,16,17,18,19,20,22,24,25,28,32,33,34,35,36,37,40,42,44,48,52,56,60\}$. Equivalently, over an empty base all four $(i,j)$ labels occur; over a nonempty subset of $\{a_1,a_2\}$ all except $11$ occur; over a nonempty subset of $\{b_1,b_2\}$ all except $00$ occur; the four mixed pairs carry alternating singleton labels; all other fibers are empty.
properties: It is an ample partial cube of VC dimension three, belongs to the convex-treelike class and hence is dismantlable, but has no affine-convex realization. It has a verified maximum parent of rank four on eight coordinates.
